integrity: No claim of independent verification, field validation or universal novelty. A directly related 2011 full text was not available; historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Exact structural reconstruction only for the classical positive Green-Ampt law with constant K and a, continuous ponded infiltration, noiseless equally spaced instrument depth levels, and a known level step. It identifies the capillary-drive product, not suction and moisture deficit separately. Numerical conditioning may be poor late in the event.
title: Four equal-depth infiltration readings with unknown volume and clock origins
